description: Keep the things you notice, the places you go, and the experiences worth remembering with Discriminantly. Add to your collection naturally through conversation with ChatGPT, revisit what you’ve kept, organize interests and travels, and turn the places you’re considering into itineraries and plans. The more you keep, the more context you have at hand when you want to remember, explore, or plan what comes next.

defaultPrompt: Keep Hatchards in London for me.
